segments.text: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,

segments.speaker: King
segments.text: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.

segments.speaker: King
segments.text: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.

segments.speaker: King
segments.text: But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.

segments.speaker: King
segments.text: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.

segments.speaker: King
segments.text: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.

segments.speaker: King
segments.text: ¶ And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:

segments.speaker: King
segments.text: And he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.

segments.speaker: King
segments.text: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: For many are called, but few are chosen.
¶ Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.
And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying,

segments.speaker: Pharisees' Disciples and Herodians
segments.text: Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any man: for thou regardest not the person of men.

segments.speaker: Pharisees' Disciples and Herodians
segments.text: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?
But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Why tempt ye me, ye hypocrites?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Shew me the tribute money.
And they brought unto him a penny.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And he saith unto them,
Whose is this

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: image and superscription?

segments.speaker: Disciples
segments.text: They say unto him, Cæsar’s.
Then saith he unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Render therefore unto Cæsar the things which are Cæsar’s; and unto God the things that are God’s.
When they had heard these words, they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.
¶ The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: And last of all the woman died also.

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.
Jesus answered and said unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.
And when the multitude heard this, they were astonished at his doctrine.
¶ But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.
Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,

segments.speaker: Lawyer
segments.text: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?
Jesus said unto him,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: This is the first and great commandment.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.
¶ While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,

segments.speaker: Pharisees
segments.text: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he?

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: They say unto him,
The Son of David.
He saith unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool?
If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?
And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.
